triggerConsent.title: Allow requests from {{name}}?
triggerConsent.intro: This app can ask CraftBot to do the following work, including when you are not viewing the app.
triggerConsent.scope: These requests can start agent work and use your connected services. Review the instructions below and allow them only if you trust this app.
triggerConsent.defaultsHint: Defaults apply when the app does not supply a value.
triggerConsent.later: Keeping requests off leaves the app usable. Closing this review leaves your current permissions unchanged. You can review them again on the app page. New or changed requests will ask again. Earlier blocked requests will not run automatically.
triggerConsent.approvalSaved: Requests are now allowed. Try the action again.
triggerConsent.on: This app can send approved requests to CraftBot.
triggerConsent.pendingChanges: New or changed agent requests are off until you review them.
triggerConsent.off: Agent requests are off until you review and allow them.
triggerConsent.blocked: {{name}} couldn't run a request because permission is required.
triggerConsent.blockedHint: Review and allow the app's requests, then try again. Blocked requests won't run automatically.
